predictions.articleTitle: Inverness CT vs Ayr Utd Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Home Control vs Road Firepower
predictions.coreRecommendation: Inverness CT's seven-match home Under 2.5 and 57.1% clean-sheet foundation supports Home Win / Draw alongside Under 2.5 Goals and BTTS: No.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Home Win / Draw driven by Inverness CT's 85.7% home unbeaten rate and 0.08 lambda parity (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Secondary Angle: Under 2.5 Goals anchored by 7/7 Inverness home matches and 4/6 Ayr away matches finishing under two-and-a-half goals (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Contingency Angle: BTTS: No via home shutout control if Ayr Utd's 33.3% away failed-to-score rate persists (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Inverness CT home defensive control tests Ayr Utd recent scoring surge

spf.comment: Retains both Inverness CT's 2:0 home-win blueprint and the 1:1 draw script because a 0.08 lambda gap and 42.9% home draw rate make a single win call fragile.

over_under.comment: Supported by the 51.3% Poisson Under 2.5 baseline alongside 7/7 Inverness CT home fixtures and 4/6 Ayr Utd away fixtures staying at two goals or fewer.

btts.comment: Inverness CT's 57.1% home clean-sheet rate and 71.4% home BTTS-No profile outweigh season-wide away concessions against an Ayr Utd side blanked in 33.3% of road games.

score.comment: Converges on 2:0 to match Inverness CT's three identical home victories by a two-goal margin, while 1:1 covers the top Poisson modal scoreline.

goals.comment: Two goals is the 25.0% Poisson modal count covering both 2:0 and 1:1, while three goals (21.8%) captures the secondary 2:1 branch if Ayr scores once.

bqc.comment: Every Inverness CT league win has been Win-Win with 0.0% home lead erosion, while both clubs carry 100.0% Draw-Draw conversion when level at half-time.
